summary: Denny Point ground lookout, Siskiyou Co., CA (Klamath NF): 1958 temporary lookout, never full-time; listed Removed and Gone; no source describes the site today.

facts.design: Temporary ground lookout, set up to look down French Creek
facts.status_note: Forest Lookouts gives the status as Removed and FFLA marks it Gone. No source gives a removal date.

events.note: Described in the Klamath National Forest Chronological History (Vol. VII, 1956-1958, as quoted on Forest Lookouts) as a temporary lookout set up to look down French Creek. The date it was set up is not given.
Manned during lightning storms; never approved as a full-time lookout

evidence.supports: 1958 entry: temporary lookout set up to look down French Creek; manned during lightning storms; never approved as full-time
evidence.quote: Denny Point was a temporary lookout set up to look down French Creek, and was manned during lightning storms. It was never approved as a full-time lookout.

evidence.supports: Siskiyou County; kind ground; status Gone; coordinates 41.44987, -122.80720
Klamath National Forest, location 42N-8W-31 as listed on the Siskiyou County page

notes_for_editor: Brief matches the sources (Siskiyou County, ground, Gone, Klamath NF). The only dated history is the 1958 Chronological History entry, quoted secondhand; the set-up date is not given, so the story says described in 1958. The 'Removed' evidence is a one-word status line on the Forest Lookouts page. No FFLOS or NHLR entry found; no photos found; mindat.com returned 403 and was not used.
